entities.summary: Maria Luisa Berti is a Sammarinese politician who was twice one of two Captains Regent. The second time she was in office from 1 October 2022 until 1 April 2023 and served alongside Manuel Ciavatta. Eleven years prior, she was in the same post for the April to October 2011 political term. Back then, it was shared with Filippo Tamagnini.
